responsibility: Implements the default generic rtl_hooks used by the RTL middle end and supplies the mutable global hook tables that passes or targets can override and later restore. It provides the standard lowpart-generation routines for registers, subregs, and MEMs, conservative default stubs for nonzero-bit and sign-bit-copy discovery and truncation knowledge, and the common helper for forming lowparts only when address validity or subreg rules allow.
